snippet.title: ADRENALINE RUSH: SAGE '25 Trailer
snippet.description:
2 videos in a row? Who does this guy think he is?? I'm me, that's what.
Anyways, yet another gameplay trailer, this time for SAGE.
The game'll be available on September 19th. You'll find it here:

sagexpo.org
sonicfangameshq.com

In the meantime, check out the non-SAGE demo:
Itch.io: https://kappa-nerd.itch.io/the-boy-and-his-story-prototype
Newgrounds: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/969060
GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/the-boy-and-his-story/934841

Music by me (Clair De Lune (Girly Mix)) (Yes, I know it's confusing with the public domain Clair De Lune, but I liked it since it's literally the tracks name in French, so I'm rockin' wit it.)
Gameplay by Huisti

Yo. Uhh... I got nothing to really say.
Umm... check out these nerds that I'm actually, like, friends with and the people that are actually special to me.

Akira - https://www.youtube.com/@akiranotok
EkuriMoon - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJ-tVyRmKu1MyQ6FKnh1akA
Huisti - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC9tOXeeE8wiOKF7GHFIOMCg
Crystal Dreemurr - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRwVHKdB3JqON-2bpXEBipQ
Oofer Princess - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCamPs90yIB0XHihgTwmZ9Pg
Protein Plus + - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCw0R_E_zvs87n_WS59v93Aw

COPPA still sucks.
Get yourself a cookie cat.

#indie #indiegame #sage2025 #speedrun #trailer
